review: Entry reuses precisely the original eight-kind writer predicate; the writer reuses that Boolean and remains inside the original shared-owner block.
Eligible reads remain before memo and budgets, without depending on current ownership. RETAIN=false still cannot read or write persistent Laurent certificates.
All mathematical operations, opaque handling, term limits, original retry, serialization and cache lock/publication/drop implementation remain byte-identical.

Tests compare eight independent exact values, retain proofs after owner drops, preserve valid other payloads, and verify new serde nodes start without proof storage. They do not assert the implementation predicate.
Existing six persistent-cache tests still cover concurrency, frontier/retry behavior and opaque-owner reclamation; all eleven P4 tests remain required.
